translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Pablo, Rey-Agripa-asabin na dukin san bendakega sunmaksad
Degi, Agripa, Pabloga sogdesun: —Na be dukin san bendakega sunmakden. Nue e-itomalaga Pablo argan onakwisgua, weyob sunmakded:
“Rey-Agripa, ibiyobi weligwar an itoge, be-asabin emi an sunmakgwisgu. Bela Judiomar-angi-gwisgunanaid-ular, dukin an na san bendake an na sokarsunnad.
Ar be nue wisid Judiomar-daed, degine, ibu-igargi anmar na abin-abin imaknanaibali. A-ular bese an egissun, bitigi bargaakwaa be nue-wis-an-itosii gusana-gadin.”
Pablo, yo Bab-Jesús-amigu, igi nanadii-gusad
Pablo sogdesun: “Ar bela Judiomar an-wisid, an sapingwagwad-akar Jerusaléngi, an-dulemar-abargi, igi an gudigusad.
Ar deginbali, bela an-wismarbalid, degine, ar sogbiele, sunna bega sogsamarbaliled, an gusgu sapingwagwad-akar Fariseo-sunnad gued. A-igar-gannarba anmar-dadgan-mesisadba an daed-dulemogad.
“Igi anmar-dadganga Bab Dummad sogsa, dule-burgwismalad ede gannar odurguoye. Bab Dummad deyob sogsad an bensuli-edarbedisoggu, a-ulale emide be-asabin an gwisgunonisunnad.

Bab Dummad deyob sogsad, degi-guoed an bensuli-edarbediidyobi wemar edarbedimogad. A-ular anmar-belagwapa Israel-dulemar-sogambe-gakabogwad mutikidba, degi, ibginedba, gwagegi Bab Dummadgi binsabukmalad. Rey-Agripa, ar a-igar an nue bensuli-edarbediid-ular, we-Judiomarse solegagwar an be-asabin selenonisunnad.
Pablo Judiomar-bukmaladga sogded: ¿Ar bemarde benmosii? ¿Ar Bab Dummadde dule-burgwisad gannar geg odulo be insae? ¿Ibiga bemar bensunna? Suli, sunna oduloge.”
Pablo Bab-Jesús-igar amis-gusadgi gannar sunmaksad
Pablo sogdebar: “An-sunnad gebeunni an binsa-daenad, Jesús-Nazaretgined-nuggi an galagwensuli egi gwisguer-gebye.

Deyob Jerusaléngi an imaksad. Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan anga igar uksadba, Jesucristogi-akananaimalad bukidar eskaryagi an mete-gusad. Degine, amar-oburgwenanaile, oburgweye, an gorgwis-damogad.

Imbagwenale, amar binnasur an sarso-daed, adi Jesúsgi bensulid ei osulogegar. Weyob bela Judiomar-onmaked-neg-yaba amar-baregindii an nanasad. Bela amar nue istar an daksoggu, neggwebur-baiganse-bakar an amar-baregindii-gusad.
“A-ulale, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan anga garda uksamargu, ibagwengi Damasco-neggweburse an nadapi,
Rey-Agripa, nega-yorukudba nibneggi gwallu dad-gaedba bur dutusur ganonikid an daksad. A-gwallu bela an-ebilis, degi, anba nadapmalad-ebilis ganonikid.

Degi, bela-anmar-nadapmalad napase aimukudmargu, gaya-burba anga Hebreo-gayaba soge an itoalid: ‘Saulo, Saulo, ¿ibiga be an-baregindii? Iko be sarsoye sogele, na be dukin nunmaked amioed. Deyobmodo, Bab-Jesús-igargi be dodoye soger, na be dukin san wiogoed.’
“Geb an sogdesun: ‘Dummad, ¿be doa-sunna?’ Degi, Dummad anga sogded: ‘Ani an Jesús, ar doa-dule be baregindiid, ani an a-duled.
Emigindi be gwisgusun, ar bese an magarononikid, adi be an-maiga guegar, degi, dulemar-baiganga, sogegar, emi be-ibmar-daksad, degi, ibmar-guoed-be-dakbaloed, sogegarbar.’
Dummad-Jesús anga sogdebar: ‘Judiomarse, degi, Judiosurmaladse an be-barmid. Amar be-oakalobi gualile, ani an be-abonogoed.

Amarse an be-barmid, adi amarga be ibya egaegar, mer neg-sichidgi bar garmakdii gumalagar, adi nabir bur gwallu-meegwadgi gudigumalagar, adi mer nia-saila-Satanás-ganguedba bar nanamalagar, adi nabir Bab-Dummad-igarba nanamalagar. Amarse an be-barmid, adi angi mer bar bengumalagar, geb degiir, e-iskudiid Bab Dummad ega elioed, degi, adi nabir nibneggi Jesucristogi-akasmaladba ibmar-nued nikumarmogoed.’ ”
Pablo, Jesús-ese-gochadba ib-imaksad
Pablo sogdebar: “Degisoggu, Rey-Agripa, Bab-Jesús nibneggi anse gochadba, mer ibmar sao-deeye, gwen an binsassulid.

Gebesaila Damascogi-bukwamaladgar-inse an sogsad, degi, Jerusalénginmaladga, geb bela Judea-yalaganba, degi, Judiosurmaladgar. Amarga an sogsad: ‘Bemar Bab Dummadse aibirmar, be-iskuedga be bukib binsamar, be-daed be ogwamar, degi, ibmar-nuegan be imakmar, adi mag be daklemalagar, bemar be-iskuedga be bukib binsasmalad, be-daed be gwagsamalad.’
“An-deyob-sunmakdiid-ulale, Judiomar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi an-gasmalad, agi, an iblobi guarmalanad.

Bab Dummad an-bendaksad-ular, amba emi-ibagi an dula bemar-abargi an gwichisunnad. Dule-dummaganga, degi, dule-yaiganaga Jesucristo-igargi an sunmakdisunnad. Igar-baigangindi gwen an sunmakdisulid, unnila Moisés, degi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad igi igargan guoye sogsadginbi an sunmakdiid.

Ar amar sogsamalad, ‘Cristo, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule, we-napnegse nonikoye, burgwegar. Burgwisad-sorba e-inse gannar durguoye, degi, gwallu-neg-mee-imakedyob anmar-Judio-dulemarga, degi, Judiosurmaladga gunonikoye.’ ”
Pablo, Rey-Agripaga soged: “Be Bab-Jesús-abingamoye”
Pablo na dukin san bendakegala weyob soggwisgu, Festo binnasur gote, sogded: —Pablo, loco an be-daked. Ibmar-dummagan-be-durdaksadi begi aibited, aga be akargud an be-daked.
Pablo, Festo-abin sogded: —Dummad-Festo, an locosur, an-ibmar-soggwichid nue-napiragwadba an soggwichid.
Ar Rey-Agripa a-ibmar nue wisid, degisoggu, agala a-asabin gwen dobsuli an sunmakgwichid. An insagua, we-ibmar-gusad bela Rey-Agripa wis an insado, ar we-ibmar arbakee dukuagwar gussulid.
Geb degi Pablo Rey-Agripaga sogdesun: —Degite Rey-Agripa: ¿Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad, we-ibmar-sogsamalad, be bensuli? An wisi, be bensulid.
Degi, Agripa Pablo-abin sogded: —Ichee-napin, sunna Bab-Jesucristoba naguega be an-imaksar-itole.

Degi Pablo, Agripa-abin sogded: —Ichee-napin-dibe, igi, ichesur-napbalin-dibe, an binsado, bitigi Bab Dummadgi be, degine, bela-an-itobukmalad an-emiskwaa-gwichiyob gusmalana-gadin. Unnila we-eskoro-dubgi an-atinnar-gwichiddi, adi deyob an be-abesurmalad.
Wegi-Pablo-ibmar-sogsad-sorba, Rey-Agripa gwisgud, degi, dummad-neg-dakmaid, Festo-nugad, degi, Berenice, agi, bela-eba-igar-itogegedgi-sigismalad gwisgudmarmosunnad.

Degi dummagan ainidmargu, bachikii na sunmaknadmalad, na muchub-muchub sogdemalad: —We-dule ibmar gwen oakalossulid, degisoggu, binsa oburgwilego-itole, aginbali, amba eskaryagi gwen mellesii-gued surbalinad.
Degi Agripa, Festoga sokar: —We-dule-eskaryagi-mellesiid sunna onolegoendo, na e-dule sogsasulina, ‘Roma-saila-dummad anga igar-nabogoye.’
